assignment.title: Benchmark Setup and Metrics
assignment.purpose: Describe the unified evaluation setup and metrics.
entry_context: Reader knows the survey's unified formulation, five-category taxonomy, and benchmark scope.

content.text: Datasets: TriviaQA, HotpotQA, CoQA for open-ended QA; TruthfulQA for closed-ended QA.
Models: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, DeepSeek-V3.2, and GPT-5-mini.
Repeated sampling uses temperature 1.0 and 5 samples; non-repeated uses temperature 0.1; 500 evaluation examples after 50 tuning examples.
AUROC measures how well the method ranks correct answers above incorrect ones.
ECE groups samples into 10 bins and measures the confidence-accuracy gap.
Brier Score is the mean squared difference between confidence and correctness, computed as Brier = (1/N) * sum_i (C(x_i, y_i) - 1{y_i = yhat_i})^2.

assignment.exit_state: Reader knows datasets, models, sampling settings, and how AUROC and ECE measure discrimination and calibration.
